text: Add agent memory to an app in three lines of code with sub-200ms context retrieval
quote: With a simple three-line API and sub-200ms retrieval, Zep helps you build personalized, reliable agents without building a context pipeline.

text: Can ingest JSON, text, and message data types into the Context Graph
quote: JSON, text, and message | Data types that you can ingest into a Context Graph.

text: Custom Entity/Edge Types let you customize entity and relation schema in the Context Graph
quote: Custom Entity/Edge Types | Feature allowing use of Pydantic-like classes to customize creation/retrieval of entities and relations in the Context Graph.

text: Provides a migration guide to move from Mem0 to Zep
quote: Migrate from Mem0 to Zep in minutes.

text: Deleting a user deletes all their threads and artifacts in one API call for right-to-be-forgotten requests
quote: This single-operation approach makes it simple to handle Right To Be Forgotten (RTBF) requests and comply with privacy regulations.

text: Memory MCP Server lets end users connect MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) to their own agent memory in Zep
quote: The Memory MCP Server lets an end user connect an MCP client (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others) to their own agent memory in Zep. The user signs in through Google Workspace or your enterprise identity provider.

text: zepctl CLI gives full terminal access to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data operations
quote: zepctl is a command-line interface for administering Zep projects. It provides full access to Zep, enabling you to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data operations from the terminal.

text: Zep generates and incrementally updates a natural-language summary of each thread
quote: A thread summary is a natural-language summary of the messages in a single thread, generated and incrementally updated by Zep.

text: Graph search combines semantic similarity search with BM25 full-text search
quote: Zep graph search combines semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search. Semantic search finds conceptual matches, and full-text search finds exact terms.

text: scope="auto" dynamically composes relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, and summaries into one ready block
quote: set scope="auto" and let Zep dynamically compose the most relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, observations, and thread summaries into a single ready-to-use block.

text: Context Block can be requested directly in the thread.add_messages() response, avoiding a separate context call
quote: You can request the Context Block directly in the response to the `thread.add_messages()` call. This optimization eliminates the need for a separate `thread.get_user_context()` call.

text: Access is governed by role-based control for dashboard users and attribute-based control for API keys/UserGroups
quote: Role-based access control governs dashboard users. Attribute-based access control governs API keys and UserGroups.

text: Deleting a node in the graph also deletes all edges connected to it
quote: Deleting a node will also delete all edges connected to that node.

text: Zep integrations provide agent memory for supported frameworks, persisting turns and retrieving from the user's Context Graph
quote: Zep provides agent memory for agents that you build with supported frameworks. The integrations persist conversation turns and retrieve data from the user's Context Graph.

text: Graphiti is an open-source temporal knowledge graph framework for local Context Graphs with bi-temporal model and fact invalidation
quote: Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework. Use it to build and query a single Context Graph per subject locally — entity and edge extraction, the bi-temporal model, fact invalidation, and hybrid retrieval.

text: Graphiti's Context Graphs can be connected to Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients via the Graphiti MCP server
quote: Connect Graphiti's Context Graphs to Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients via the Graphiti MCP server.

text: Zep can be deployed to the cloud or into your own VPC
quote:
Deploy anywhere

CloudYour VPC

text: Application user creation triggers creation of a corresponding Zep user for per-user memory scoping
quote: Whenever users are created in your application, you need to trigger the creation of a Zep user.

text: thread.add_messages adds chat messages to thread history and ingests them into the user's knowledge graph
quote: Chat messages are added to threads using thread.add_messages, which adds the messages to the thread history and ingests them into the user's Context Graph.

text: Edges can be deleted from the graph via client.graph.edge.delete(uuid_=...)
quote: Here's how to delete an edge from a graph: client.graph.edge.delete(uuid_="your_edge_uuid")

text: ABAC policies provide least-privilege scoped access to context for agents and Memory MCP users
quote: Use RBAC for humans. Use policies when you need least-privilege access to context for agents and Memory MCP users.

text: Graphiti's context graphs track how facts change over time, maintain provenance, and support prescribed/learned ontologies
quote: Graphiti's context graphs track how facts change over time, maintain provenance to source data, and support both prescribed and learned ontology

text: Zep builds a Context Graph from chat messages, business data, documents, and JSON
quote: Zep builds a Context Graph from chat messages, business data, documents, and JSON.

text: Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents, unlike static knowledge graphs
quote: Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents. Unlike static knowledge graphs, Graphiti's context graphs track how facts change over time

text: MCP integration lets Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code Copilot interact with Graphiti's Context Graph for persistent context
quote: This enables AI assistants like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code with Copilot to interact with Graphiti's Context Graph capabilities, providing persistent context and contextual awareness.

text: Zep delivers sub-200ms context retrieval regardless of graph size or number of graphs
quote: Zep delivers sub-200ms context retrieval regardless of graph size or number of graphs.

text: ABAC policies limit which actions and context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach
quote: Limit which actions and context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach with ABAC policies attached to API keys and UserGroups.

text: Supports agent memory integrations for LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, AutoGen, LiveKit, Strands, Vercel AI SDK, Eve, and others
quote: Use Zep as agent memory with LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, AutoGen, LiveKit, Strands, Vercel AI SDK, Eve, and other supported frameworks.

text: Zep applies authorization and audit controls to Context Graph operations
quote: Zep applies authorization and audit controls to Context Graph operations. Role-based access control governs dashboard users.

text: Graphiti MCP Server exposes Graphiti's core functionality via the Model Context Protocol
quote: The Graphiti MCP Server is an experimental implementation that exposes Graphiti's key functionality through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

text: Official Python SDK installable via pip install zep-cloud
quote: pip install zep-cloud

text: return_context=True on add_messages triggers a graph search and returns context relevant to newly added messages
quote: you can pass in the return_context=True flag to the thread.add_messages() method. Zep will perform a user graph search right after persisting the data and return the context relevant to the recently added messages.

text: Framework integrations support agent memory, Context Graph search, and context placement
quote: Zep integrations for agent frameworks support agent memory, Context Graph search, and context placement.

text: Audit Logs record dashboard activity and API Logs record supported API request activity
quote: Audit Logs record dashboard activity, and API Logs record supported API request activity.
